arguments.prompt:
Create a premium HAVENLINE sculpted 3D game-asset reference sheet. Match the supplied Havenline style reference: confident chunky silhouettes, broad clean bevels, subtly carved warm timber, convincing blue or dark steel, bronze fasteners where the source shows them, pale stone and selective clean snow on exposed ledges. Keep source-specific roof, canvas, glass and metal colors. Use refined animated-feature/PBR-like rendering, soft studio illumination, crisp useful detail, and quiet contact shadows. Use a pale warm-gray studio background, generous gutters and complete uncropped objects. Avoid photoreal grime, painterly noise, glossy toy-plastic flattening, extra characters, decorative piles, fake UI, promotional badges, and crowded copied-board graphics. This is deliberate production reference art with clear geometry and a small clean sans-serif heading.

REFERENCES IN ACTUAL ORDER
Reference 1: Havenline: Frostbound World Atlas.png — Original user world atlas; only the explicitly identified family/column/row is identity authority.
Reference 2: defense-platform-turnaround-r2.png — Reviewed Havenline material and rendering style ONLY: broad sculpted bevels, warm timber, blue steel, restrained snow, pale studio background. Do not copy the defense platform geometry.

SUBJECT: FUTURE CONCEPT | FORTRESS WALL UPGRADE EXAMPLES.
Use only the atlas WALLS column, top/middle/bottom examples, as three future wall concepts A/B/C. Preserve the light block-and-pier first form, the heavier developed stone/blue-accent middle form, and the darker metal-armored lower form with its visible warm metal fasteners/top accents. Reproduce their actual source panel silhouettes and end piers rather than inventing three new palisades. Show both the outside face and consistent supported rear in the opposing angle. No combat statistics, invented upgrade levels or expanded fortress scene.

SOURCE ANCHORS
- Havenline: Frostbound World Atlas.png: Walls example1; upgrade examples (some of many), Walls column, row1
- Havenline: Frostbound World Atlas.png: Walls example2; upgrade examples (some of many), Walls column, row2
- Havenline: Frostbound World Atlas.png: Walls example3; upgrade examples (some of many), Walls column, row3

SHEET
Small heading: HAVENLINE | FUTURE CONCEPT | FORTRESS WALL UPGRADE EXAMPLES. Requested landscape canvas 1536 × 1024, with detail large enough to judge. Six large panels in a 3-column by 2-row landscape sheet. Each column is one source form: front-left above its matching rear-right view. Use the source form order given below.
Required panels:
- ATLAS EXAMPLE A / FRONT-LEFT: Opposing geometry and identity reference
- ATLAS EXAMPLE A / REAR-RIGHT: Opposing geometry and identity reference
- ATLAS EXAMPLE B / FRONT-LEFT: Opposing geometry and identity reference
- ATLAS EXAMPLE B / REAR-RIGHT: Opposing geometry and identity reference
- ATLAS EXAMPLE C / FRONT-LEFT: Opposing geometry and identity reference
- ATLAS EXAMPLE C / REAR-RIGHT: Opposing geometry and identity reference

The two opposing three-quarter views of a form must show ONE fixed design from front-left and rear-right; rotate the camera around it, do not mirror the image. Keep doors, windows, chimneys, pipe runs, roof pitch, support posts, snow patches, planks, handles, annexes and material assignments in the same physical positions. Preserve the distinct source silhouettes; do not make variants by recoloring one duplicated model. The source boards mostly show one side, so rear faces and any opened interiors are restrained concept interpretations. Add the short footer SOURCE-BASED CONCEPT · UNSEEN SURFACES INTERPRETED. Do not print invented levels, costs, capacities, rates, recipes, unlocks, dimensions or gameplay claims. Source-visible props remain aesthetic context; no new production chain, crop list, animal drop, weapon mechanism or runtime behavior is established.
This sheet is an atlas future visual concept. Label example forms A/B/C by their source row, never as invented numerical upgrade tiers. It does not replace an existing approved asset or claim a playable region.
